messages:
Anna: Quick heads-up — thinking about tightening the ARB agenda so meetings are more predictable and easier to facilitate. Proposal: compact RFC blocks (20m), Q&A (10m), lightning updates (5m), then 5m for actions/followups. Also want to rotate facilitators in 2-week handovers and keep a short handoff note in a shared doc. Who can take the next 2-week facilitator slot?

Mike: I can take weeks 1-2 if that helps. Prefer having a pinned agenda in the calendar invite. :thumbsup:

Sophia: Happy to do weeks 3-4. Quick Q: are we still preserving the open triage slot for urgent platform issues?

Anna: Yes — keep a 10m triage overflow after the RFC/Q&A block for high-priority stuff. The compact agenda looks like:```
- 00:00 - 00:02 quick admin + facilitator intro
- 00:02 - 00:22 RFC deep dive (presenter + 10m reviewer feedback)
- 00:22 - 00:32 Q&A / discussion
- 00:32 - 00:37 lightning ops/announcements
- 00:37 - 00:40 triage overflow and action items
```
Putting the RFC block at 20m keeps reviews focused.

Jordan: Love the shape. Two requests: (1) add a "PR blocking" tag so reviewers know urgency, (2) can we alternate times to avoid SRE oncall clashes (Tues 11am is rough for them).

Lee: I can maintain the facilitator handover doc — I'll add a template with: facilitator name, week dates, primary agenda items, followups, calendar RSVPs to update. Will link it here when done.

Riley: Small UX ask — can presenters paste one slide or a 1-paragraph TL;DR in the thread before the meeting? speeds things up.

Mike: Agreed re: TL;DR. Also +1 on rotating to avoid oncall conflicts. Maybe we do a 2-week rotation but shift the weekday every other rotation?

Anna: Good idea. For next facilitator slots: Mike (1785551212) weeks 1-2, Sophia weeks 3-4, Jordan volunteered as backup. Lee will own the handover doc. Riley to add a short TL;DR guideline.

Calendar-bot: Created event "ARB — compact agenda trial" (recurring). Attendees: @eng-platform. Link: https://calendar.example/arb-compact-1785551212

Sophia: Can someone add a short checklist for RFC presenters: target decisions, open questions, perf/cost impact, rollout plan. I can draft one.

Lee: Draft checklist added to the handover doc: https://docs.example/arb-handover-checklist (please review).

Jordan: Minor logistics — can we enforce a 3-slide max per RFC or we'll exceed the time. :sweat_smile:

Mike: I'll post the facilitator availability poll for the next quarter in #eng-platform. Let's keep this trial for 4 meetings and then iterate.

Anna: Thanks all. Action items: Mike/Sophia/Lee/Riley register in the handover doc, Mike posts poll, Sophia drafts RFC checklist. We'll evaluate after 4 runs. :sparkles:
